## DIARRHEA WITH CHOLERA (VIBRIO CHOLERAE)
## Primary Treatment
Aggressive hydration and electrolyte replacement are essential
## Antimicrobial treatment
Primary:
## Inpatient

Doxycycline 300 mg PO one-time dose [DI]
Alternative:
Ciprofloxacin 1000 mg PO one-time dose [R,DI]
< OR >
Azithromycin 1000 mg PO one-time dose [M]
